name: ratchet
description: Plan-and-verify workflow. Grill the goal, write a PRD, spec and design log, roast the plan, then push small checkpoints through a deterministic engine: red tests, behaviour, visual, two blind reviewers whose findings block only with a proof or a rule ID, and your approval. Also fix, verify, handover/resume and why flows, STE-lite document checks, and a nightly dream that reads all your sessions and proposes rules for you to approve.
